name: What’s included in ground-up construction pricing versus excluded items?

mainEntity.name: Does a ground-up construction quote in Los Angeles include land, permits, design, and landscaping?
mainEntity.text: Does a ground-up construction quote in Los Angeles include land, permits, design, and landscaping?

acceptedAnswer.text: A ground-up construction estimate can look complete while still leaving out major project costs. Land acquisition is almost always separate. Depending on the proposal, design fees, engineering, permits, plan check, utility upgrades, landscaping, appliances, and some site work may also be excluded. That is why owners should ask for a detailed scope breakdown before comparing bids. A low number can be misleading if it only covers the structure and finishes but not the work needed to make the home fully functional and approved. The safest budgeting method is to separate hard costs, soft costs, site costs, and owner-selected extras. That gives a more accurate view of the real total required to finish the home and move in without surprises.
acceptedAnswer.description: A construction quote usually covers the building work, but land, architectural design, engineering, financing, and many outside costs may be excluded unless the proposal says otherwise. Landscaping, appliances, furnishings, and site-specific upgrades are also commonly separate. Always check whether the quote is for hard construction only or for the full project budget.
